direct finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID conclusion from generated-proxy diagnostics

route to scenario redesign if generated-proxy diagnostic panel is not sufficient
route to controlled current-sim comparison design only if audit justifies it

one follow-up manifest for synthesis scenario redesign or controlled comparison design

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2145 audits diagnostic comparison and does not test history necessity.
